item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena keeps some dry moong seeds in a jar in her kitchen. When she soaks a few of them in water overnight, they begin to sprout small roots. Why should the dry moong seeds be classified as living things?

options.A: They are living because they can germinate and grow into new plants under suitable conditions.
options.B: They are living because they are hard and dry and do not change over time.
options.C: They are non-living because they do not move from one place to another on their own.
options.D: They are non-living because they were once part of a plant that has now been harvested.
